zh-CN.name: 彩虹流光
zh-CN.note: 彩虹沿双环镜像流动

en.name: Rainbow Flow
en.note: A mirrored rainbow flows around both rings.

zh-CN.name: 极光波纹
zh-CN.note: 青绿、蓝紫光带缓慢起伏

en.name: Aurora Waves
en.note: Slow cyan-green and blue-violet light bands.

zh-CN.name: 熔岩流动
zh-CN.note: 暗红底色，橙金亮带涌动

en.name: Lava Flow
en.note: Orange-gold bands move over a dark red base.

zh-CN.name: 星河微光
zh-CN.note: 不同灯珠错峰明灭

en.name: Starfield
en.note: Individual cyan, blue and white stars fade in and out.

zh-CN.name: 同步呼吸
zh-CN.note: 双环同步，青蓝到紫色渐变

en.name: Synced Breathing
en.note: Both rings breathe together, shifting cyan to purple.

zh-CN.name: 交替呼吸
zh-CN.note: 左青右粉，此亮彼暗

en.name: Alternating Breath
en.note: Left cyan and right pink alternate in brightness.

zh-CN.name: 心跳脉冲
zh-CN.note: 一强一弱两次脉冲，随后停歇

en.name: Heartbeat
en.note: One strong pulse, one weaker pulse, then a pause.

zh-CN.name: 彗星拖尾
zh-CN.note: 冰蓝光点带渐隐尾迹

en.name: Comet Trail
en.note: An icy blue point moves with a soft fading tail.

zh-CN.name: 双彗星对转
zh-CN.note: 每圈青粉彗星相向绕行，交汇时混色

en.name: Twin Comets
en.note: Cyan and pink comets counter-rotate inside each ring.

zh-CN.name: 霓虹旋翼
zh-CN.note: 每圈四片青紫光刃旋转

en.name: Neon Rotor
en.note: Four soft cyan-purple blades rotate on each ring.

zh-CN.name: 往返扫描
zh-CN.note: 光带从底部向顶部扫描，再返回

en.name: Up-Down Scan
en.note: A light band scans from bottom to top and back.

zh-CN.name: 扩散波纹
zh-CN.note: 从中间按键向灯环扩散，消退后重来

en.name: Expanding Ripple
en.note: A wave travels from center keys into both rings, then fades.

zh-CN.name: 充能爆发
zh-CN.note: 按键逐级充能、铺满双环，亮白后渐暗

en.name: Charge Burst
en.note: Keys charge into full rings, flash white and fade.

zh-CN.name: 自定义油门灯
zh-CN.note: 配色、走向、起点使用 v15map 保存的设置

en.name: Custom Throttle
en.note: Uses the palette, direction and start saved by v15map.

zh-CN.name: 彩虹油门
zh-CN.note: 红橙→黄绿→青蓝→紫；左顺右逆，内下角起

en.name: Rainbow Throttle
en.note: Red to purple; left CW / right CCW, inner-bottom start.

zh-CN.name: 冰蓝油门
zh-CN.note: 深蓝→青→冰白；左顺右逆，内下角起

en.name: Ice Throttle
en.note: Blue to cyan-white; mirrored, inner-bottom start.

zh-CN.name: 火焰油门
zh-CN.note: 红橙→橙→金黄；左顺右逆，内下角起

en.name: Fire Throttle
en.note: Red-orange to gold; mirrored, inner-bottom start.

zh-CN.name: 青粉油门
zh-CN.note: 青→淡蓝→粉；左顺右逆，内下角起

en.name: Cyan-Pink Throttle
en.note: Cyan to pale blue to pink; mirrored, inner-bottom.

zh-CN.name: 薄荷油门
zh-CN.note: 绿→青绿→蓝；左顺右逆，内下角起

en.name: Mint Throttle
en.note: Green to teal to blue; mirrored, inner-bottom.

zh-CN.name: 纯青蓝油门
zh-CN.note: 纯色；左顺右逆，内下角起；可辅助排查乱色

en.name: Solid Cyan
en.note: Solid cyan-blue; mirrored, inner-bottom start.

zh-CN.name: 纯紫油门
zh-CN.note: 纯色；左顺右逆，内下角起

en.name: Solid Purple
en.note: Solid purple; mirrored, inner-bottom start.

zh-CN.name: 纯金油门
zh-CN.note: 纯色；左顺右逆，内下角起

en.name: Solid Gold
en.note: Solid gold; mirrored, inner-bottom start.

zh-CN.name: 反向彩虹
zh-CN.note: 左逆右顺，内下角起

en.name: Reversed Rainbow
en.note: Left CCW / right CW, inner-bottom start.

zh-CN.name: 双向展开
zh-CN.note: 青粉渐变，从正下方向圆环两边展开

en.name: Split Expansion
en.note: Cyan-pink expands both ways from the bottom.

zh-CN.name: 顶部起亮
zh-CN.note: 冰蓝渐变，从正上方起，左顺右逆

en.name: Top Start
en.note: Ice palette; starts at top, left CW / right CCW.

zh-CN.name: 双环顺时针
zh-CN.note: 彩虹渐变，两圈都顺时针，正下方起

en.name: Both Clockwise
en.note: Rainbow; both rings clockwise, bottom start.

zh-CN.name: 双环逆时针
zh-CN.note: 绿蓝渐变，两圈都逆时针，外下角起

en.name: Both Counter-CW
en.note: Green-blue; both rings counterclockwise, outer-bottom.

zh-CN.name: 油门加力
zh-CN.note: 橙金进度叠加移动亮斑，油门越大越快

en.name: Afterburner
en.note: Throttle bar plus a moving hotspot; faster at high throttle.

zh-CN.name: 双杆瞄准
zh-CN.note: 各自跟随对应摇杆的方向和偏转幅度

en.name: Stick Aim
en.note: Each ring follows its physical stick direction and deflection.

zh-CN.name: 双杆调色台
zh-CN.note: 左杆调色和亮度；右杆调速度、方向和光带宽度

en.name: Stick Color Mixer
en.note: Left: color/brightness. Right: speed/direction/width.

zh-CN.name: 双杆旋涡
zh-CN.note: 左右各自调速、反向和调色，横向居中停转

en.name: Stick Vortex
en.note: Each stick controls its ring speed, direction and color.

zh-CN.name: 双杆组合拳
zh-CN.note: 两步水平动作触发粉白星环、冰蓝冲击或彩虹回旋

en.name: Stick Combos
en.note: Two-step horizontal gestures trigger three short bursts.
